app.name: VNDub
stepper.label: Steps
resume.title: Continue where you left off?
resume.text: Last time the work was interrupted. You can continue: everything that was already done is saved.
resume.keep_shutdown: Turn the computer off when it is finished
resume.keep_shutdown_hint: The interrupted run was set to turn the computer off. Without the tick the computer stays on.
report.done: The report is ready. It has no audio, only logs and settings.
route.A.name: A: clone the original voice directly
route.A.hint: Fast, but an accent is possible: the timbre is taken from the original recordings.
route.B.name: B: own voice, converted to match the original
route.B.hint: Best likeness to the original, but the voice needs time to train.
route.C.name: C: fine-tune on the best lines
route.C.hint: The slowest route; useful when A and B do not sound quite right.
manual.download.title: Download the file manually
manual.download.step1: Open the link in a browser and download the file:
manual.download.step3: Put it into the app data folder (the button below opens it) and press Retry.
doctor.title: Computer check
doctor.intro: Before we start, let us check that everything is ready: graphics card, disk space, required programs. It takes a few seconds.
doctor.summary.warn: There are remarks, but you can work.
doctor.summary.fail: There are problems that are best solved first.
doctor.gpu_warning.none.title: No NVIDIA graphics card found
doctor.gpu_warning.none.text: Dubbing is designed for an NVIDIA graphics card with 8 GB of video memory. Without it the app will be very slow: dubbing one game can take weeks, and some models will not start at all. If you do have such a card, update its driver.
doctor.gpu_warning.low.title: Not much video memory
doctor.gpu_warning.low.text: Your graphics card has {vram} GB of video memory, while the app is designed for 8 GB. Some models will not start and the rest will be slower. Close other programs that use the graphics card, such as games and browsers playing video.
doctor.gpu.title: Graphics card
doctor.gpu.yellow: A graphics card was found: {name}, but it is not a recommended one.
doctor.gpu.red: No NVIDIA graphics card found. Dubbing will be very slow or will not work.
doctor.driver.title: Graphics driver
doctor.driver.yellow: The driver is a bit old (CUDA {cuda}): version {min_cuda} or newer is needed. Updating it is recommended.
doctor.driver.yellow.cuda_unknown: The CUDA version of driver {driver} could not be determined. If dubbing does not start, update the driver.
doctor.driver.red: The driver is too old (CUDA {cuda}): version {min_cuda} or newer is needed. Install a recent NVIDIA driver.
doctor.driver.red.no_driver: No NVIDIA driver was found. Install a recent driver.
doctor.vram.title: Video memory
doctor.vram.green: There is enough video memory: {vram_gb} GB.
doctor.vram.yellow: Video memory is tight: {vram_gb} GB, {need_gb} GB recommended. Some models will have to be switched off.
doctor.vram.yellow.unknown: The amount of video memory could not be determined. About {need_gb} GB is needed.
doctor.vram.red: Video memory is too low: {vram_gb} GB, about {need_gb} GB needed. Most models will not start.
doctor.vram.red.no_nvidia: Without an NVIDIA graphics card there is no video memory, and about {need_gb} GB is needed.
doctor.disk.title: Disk space
doctor.disk.green: There is enough free space: {free_gb} GB (about {need_gb} GB needed).
doctor.disk.yellow: Free space is low: {free_gb} GB, a full installation needs about {need_gb} GB.
doctor.disk.red: Almost no free space: {free_gb} GB, {need_gb} GB needed. Free some space or choose another data folder in Settings.
doctor.ffmpeg.title: Audio program (ffmpeg)
doctor.ffmpeg.yellow: ffmpeg is installed, but the version is old. Updating is recommended.
doctor.ffmpeg.red: Not found: {missing}. Audio cannot be processed without it. You can download it with one button.
doctor.vcredist.title: Microsoft Visual C++ (runtime)
doctor.vcredist.green: Installed: version {version}. Every model needs it.
doctor.vcredist.green.not_applicable: Nothing needs to be done on this system.
doctor.vcredist.yellow: Could not check whether the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime is installed. If the models do not start, install it from the Microsoft website.
doctor.vcredist.red: The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime is not installed. No model can start without it: not translation, not voice synthesis, not speech recognition.
doctor.vcredist.red.too_old: The installed Microsoft Visual C++ runtime is too old: {version}, but {min_version} or newer is needed. The models may fail to start until it is updated.
doctor.git.title: Git (needed to install environments)
doctor.git.green.bundled: Using the Git that comes with VNDub: {path}
doctor.git.yellow: Git not found. It is needed to install the environments: {envs}. Install Git (git-scm.com) and restart VNDub.
doctor.git.yellow.bundled_missing: The Git that comes with VNDub was not found: the git folder next to VNDub.exe was deleted or damaged. It is needed to install the environments: {envs}. Reinstall VNDub or install Git (git-scm.com).
doctor.git.red: Git not found. It is needed to install the environments: {envs}. Install Git (git-scm.com) and restart VNDub.
doctor.internet.title: Internet
doctor.internet.green: The internet is reachable. It is only needed to download models and programs.
doctor.internet.yellow: No internet or it does not respond. Models and programs cannot be downloaded; everything else works offline.
doctor.internet.red: No internet. Models and programs cannot be downloaded; everything else works offline.
doctor.defender.title: Windows Defender
doctor.defender.green: Nothing needs to be done on this system.
doctor.defender.yellow: Windows Defender can slow things down and wrongly block files. We recommend adding the data folder to its exclusions: {path}
doctor.defender.red: Windows Defender is blocking working files. Add the data folder to its exclusions: {path}
doctor.envs.title: Model environments
doctor.envs.yellow: Environments installed: {present} of {total}. Missing: {missing}. You can install them with one button.
doctor.envs.red: Model environments are not installed ({total} needed). Dubbing is impossible without them.
doctor.models.title: Models
doctor.models.green: The required models are downloaded: {present} of {total}.
doctor.models.yellow: Models downloaded: {present} of {total}. The minimum set is enough, but it is better to download the rest (about {missing_gb} GB).
doctor.models.red: The required models are not downloaded ({present} of {total}); minimum set: {min_present} of {min_total}. Dubbing is impossible without them.
doctor.fix.add_defender_exclusion_help: Show how to add an exclusion
doctor.defender_help.title: How to exclude a folder from Windows Defender scans
doctor.defender_help.intro: Windows Defender sometimes slows things down and mistakes working files for a threat. To avoid that, add the data folder to its exclusions:
doctor.defender_help.step1: Open Windows Security, then Virus & threat protection.
doctor.defender_help.step2: Choose Manage settings, then at the very bottom Add or remove exclusions.
doctor.defender_help.step3: Press Add an exclusion, choose Folder and select this folder: {path}
errors.internal.title: Something went wrong inside the app.
errors.internal.hint: Press Build a problem report and send the file to the developer, then try again.
errors.bad_request.title: The app received an invalid request.
errors.bad_request.hint: Go back one step and repeat the action. If it keeps happening, build a problem report.
errors.cancelled.title: The operation was cancelled.
errors.cancelled.hint: Press Retry when you are ready to start again.
errors.tool_missing.title: The program “{tool}”, which is needed for this action, was not found.
errors.tool_missing.hint: Press Install programs and download it with one button.
errors.weights_missing.title: The model “{model}” has not been downloaded.
errors.env_missing.title: The environment “{env}” is not installed.
errors.env_missing.hint: Open the programs and environments page and press Install environments.
errors.backend_unavailable.title: The required model is not available right now.
errors.backend_unavailable.hint: Open Models: it may not be downloaded or may not fit in video memory.
errors.stage_failed.title: The step “{stage}” failed.
errors.stage_failed.hint: Press Retry. If it fails again, build a problem report.
errors.file_not_found.title: A file or folder was not found: {path}.
errors.file_not_found.hint: Check that the file or folder is in place and try again.
errors.permission_denied.title: No access to the file or folder: {path}.
errors.permission_denied.hint: Choose a folder you can write to (for example in Documents), or open the data folder and check its permissions.
errors.project_not_found.title: The project for this game was not found.
errors.project_not_found.hint: Choose the game folder again on the Game step.
errors.no_project.title: No game has been chosen yet.
errors.no_project.hint: Choose the game folder on the Game step.
errors.job_not_found.title: This operation is no longer current.
errors.job_busy.title: Another operation is already running.
errors.job_busy.hint: Wait for it to finish, or stop it with the Cancel button.
errors.sample_too_short.title: The voice sample is too short.
errors.sample_too_short.hint: Upload a recording between 5 and 20 seconds long.
errors.sample_too_long.title: The voice sample is too long.
errors.sample_too_long.hint: Trim the recording to 5-20 seconds and upload it again.
errors.sample_bad_format.title: The sample file could not be read.
errors.sample_bad_format.hint: Upload a file in WAV or MP3 format.
errors.download_unreachable.title: The file “{filename}” could not be downloaded.
errors.download_unreachable.hint: Check your internet connection and press Retry, or download the file manually using the link below.
errors.hf_bad_url.title: This does not look like a Hugging Face model link.
errors.hf_bad_url.hint: Use an address like https://huggingface.co/owner/model (or just "owner/model"). Other sites are not supported.
errors.hf_not_found.title: There is no such model on Hugging Face.
errors.hf_not_found.hint: Check the address. Private models are visible only with a Hugging Face token (the HF_TOKEN environment variable).
errors.hf_gated.title: This model requires accepting a license.
errors.hf_gated.hint: Open the model page {page_url} and accept the terms. Then log in to Hugging Face: set a token in the HF_TOKEN environment variable or run "hf auth login". After that, try again.
errors.checksum_mismatch.title: The downloaded file is damaged.
errors.checksum_mismatch.hint: Press Retry to download it again.
errors.install_manual_only.title: For this game the patch has to be installed manually.
errors.install_manual_only.hint: Follow the step-by-step instructions on this screen: the app cannot do it by itself.
errors.no_gpu.title: No NVIDIA graphics card was found.
errors.no_gpu.hint: Open Diagnostics and check the driver. Without a graphics card dubbing will be very slow.
errors.low_vram.title: There is less video memory than this operation needs.
errors.low_vram.hint: Close other programs that use the graphics card, or choose lighter models.
errors.disk_full.title: There is not enough disk space.
errors.disk_full.hint: Free some space or choose another data folder in Settings.
errors.game_dir_invalid.title: No game was found in this folder.
errors.game_dir_invalid.hint: Choose the folder that holds the game's executable (.exe) and its data.
errors.nothing_to_review.title: There is nothing to review yet.
errors.nothing_to_review.hint: First run the full run on the Full run step.
errors.nothing_to_install.title: There is no finished patch to install.
errors.nothing_to_install.hint: Finish the full run and come back to this step.
errors.server_unreachable.title: The app's background service does not respond.
errors.server_unreachable.hint: Close the window and open VNDub again.

stages.text_emotion: Working out the delivery from the text

job.warn.mixed_models: The translation was made by several models (lines): {models}. The style may differ.
job.warn.settings_changed: Settings changed since the interruption: {keys}. The work went on with the new ones.
job.warn.group.speaker: voice similarity
player.play_both: Compare: original first, then the dub
player.error: The audio could not be loaded.
game.title: Game
game.intro: Choose the folder with the game. The app finds the lines and voices, works out who says what and prepares everything for dubbing. The game files are not changed.
game.analyze_hint: It takes a few minutes. You can minimise the window.
stale_import.title: The game was analysed by an older version of the app
stale_import.game_text: Since then the way Ren'Py dialogue identifiers are computed has changed: the game finds the voice of lines that had no voice of their own by them. Analyse the game again and then run the full run: finished translations and voices are kept, the patch is built again.
stale_import.run_text: The game was analysed by an older version of the app, and Ren'Py dialogue identifiers have been computed differently since then: the game finds the voice of lines without a voice of their own by them. Analyse the game again in the Game step first, then start the run: finished translations and voices are kept.
game.analyzing: Listening to intonation / reading the text
game.empty: No lines were found in this folder. Check that you chose the game's own folder and try again.
game.tools_missing.title: This game needs extra programs
game.tools_missing.text: Without them the text and voices cannot be extracted from the game files.
game.tool_needed: Needed to read this game's files.
game.encrypted.title: The game files are encrypted
game.encrypted.text: The game protects its files with encryption, so the text and voices cannot be taken from it directly. A small extra utility is needed; the steps below show how to use it.
game.drm.title: The game has copy protection
engine.drm.steam: A Steam game (Steam protection files were found). This usually does not get in the way.
engine.drm.softdenchi: SoftDenchi protection found: the game files may be inaccessible.
engine.drm.dmm: A DMM Game Player game: the files may be protected and inaccessible.
engine.drm.dlsite_playdrm: A DLsite Play game with PlayDRM protection: the files may be inaccessible.
engine.drm.enigma: Enigma Protector found: the game files may be packed and inaccessible.
engine.drm.unknown: Copy protection detected: {name}. The game files may be inaccessible.
summary.warning.experimental: Support for this engine is experimental: the result needs especially careful checking.
summary.warning.unreadable: Some of the game files could not be read.
summary.warning.other: The game has quirks that can make analysis harder.
game.found.title: What was found in the game
game.analysis: Intonation: {audio} from the voice recordings, {text} from the text of the lines.
game.mode_b.title: The game has no voice acting
game.mode_b.text: The game has no voice acting: voices will be chosen from the characters' descriptions and the intonation from the text.
game.mapping.title: How reliably the voices match the text
game.mapping.high: The matching looks reliable: voices fit the characters and recording lengths fit the text lengths.
game.mapping.medium: The matching is mostly reliable, but some lines look doubtful. You can see them below; it does not stop you from continuing.
game.mapping.low: There are many doubtful matches. It is better to turn on the speech-recognition check (slow but accurate).
game.mapping.no_asr: The check ran without speech recognition (fast mode).
game.asr.suggest_text: Too many lines have a voice or length that does not fit the text. You can check the matching with speech recognition. It is slow, but reliable.
game.asr.button: Check the matching with speech recognition, slow
game.asr.text: Usually this is not needed: the text comes from the game itself and the voice recordings are used only as a model of intonation. Turn the check on if you notice that voices ended up with the wrong lines.
game.no_text.title: {n} lines have a voice but no text
game.no_text.text: Most likely the game's script cannot be read directly. Only for these lines can the speech in the voice recordings be recognised to get the text. It may contain mistakes: such lines will be marked and you can fix them during review.
game.no_text.button: Recognise the text from the voice
game.characters.title: Characters
game.characters.name: Character
game.characters.unvoiced_hint: For these lines we will pick the voice from the character description and work out the intonation from the text and the narrator's remarks.
game.problems.title: Problem files ({n})
game.problems.text: The app could not match these lines with confidence. It does not stop you from continuing: you can check them later on the Review step.
game.reason.spk_outlier: the voice does not sound like the character's other lines
game.reason.duration_implausible: the recording length does not fit the text length
game.reason.order_gap: the order of lines is broken
game.advanced.title: Advanced
manual.krkrdump.title: How to get the files out of an encrypted KiriKiri Z game
manual.krkrdump.intro: The game decrypts its own files while it runs. The KrkrDump utility watches this and saves the decrypted files. Three steps:
manual.krkrdump.step1.title: 1. Download KrkrDump and put it next to the game
manual.krkrdump.step1.text: Copy version.dll from the KrkrDump archive into the game folder, next to the game's executable (.exe).
manual.krkrdump.step2.title: 2. Start the game and play the scenes you need
manual.krkrdump.step2.text: The utility saves only what the game has already read. Play until you have opened all the scenes you want to dub.
manual.krkrdump.step3.title: 3. Close the game and come back here
manual.krkrdump.step3.text: Press Analyse again: the app will find the saved files and carry on.
translate.title: Translation and settings
translate.intro: Choose the language and how to translate. Changes are saved automatically. If in doubt, leave everything as it is: the defaults suit most games.
translate.source_lang.unknown: The language is detected when the game is imported
translate.same_lang: The game text already is in the target language: lines are kept as they are, the translation model is not started.
translate.source.auto_hint: A model on your computer does the translation, offline.
translate.source.import_hint: Connect a ready file or folder with the translation: then no translation model is needed.
translate.no_llm.title: The translation model is not downloaded
translate.no_llm.text: To translate automatically you need to download the translation model. Or connect a ready translation above.
translate.import.path: File or folder with the translation
translate.import.type_path: The file dialog is not available: paste the path into the field above.
translate.import.formats: JSON, JSONL, CSV, XLSX files and VNTextPatch export folders work.
translate.import.none_matched: No line matched. Check that the translation was made for this game.
translate.honorifics.keep_hint: Familiar to those who watch anime.
translate.honorifics.adapt: Replace with Russian forms of address
translate.honorifics.adapt_hint: For example “Miss” or a formal form of address where it fits.
translate.license.research_hint: All models are available, including those that cannot be used commercially; the dub must not be sold.
translate.license.commercial_hint: Only models that may be used commercially; some of the best voices will be unavailable.
translate.advanced.title: Advanced
translate.advanced.n_candidates: How many dub variants to try for each line
translate.advanced.n_candidates_hint: More variants give a better result, but the work takes longer.
translate.advanced.backends_hint: For each model the video memory it needs and its licence are shown.
translate.advanced.filtered: will be switched off under the commercial policy
translate.advanced.asr_check: Check the matching with speech recognition, slow
translate.advanced.asr_check_hint: Needed only if voices ended up with the wrong lines.
translate.run.title: Translating the lines
translate.run.text: When the settings are ready, start the translation. It is needed next for the voice samples.
translate.run.done_text: The translation is ready. You can go on to choosing voices, or translate again with new settings.
translate.run.stale: The settings changed after the translation. If it matters (language, forms of address, glossary), translate again.
glossary.title: Names and terms
glossary.characters_hint: How the name is spelled in Russian and the character's gender. Endings in the translation depend on the gender.
glossary.terms_hint: Words that must always be translated the same way: names of places, schools, techniques.
cues.title: Cue table: how the narrator's words affect intonation
cues.hint: For unvoiced lines the intonation is worked out from the text and the words around it, such as “whispered” or “angrily”. Here you can adjust the emotion, strength and pace that match each word.
cues.truncated: The first {n} rows are shown. Use the search.
models.title: Models
models.intro: Models are the brains of the app: some translate, some voice the lines, some check the quality. They are downloaded once; after that no internet is needed.
models.preset.min_hint: Minimum: one voice, translation and quality scoring. Enough to try things out.
models.preset.recommended_hint: Recommended set: the best balance of quality and size for an 8 GB graphics card.
models.preset.all_hint: All models: needs a lot of disk space, but every dubbing route is available.
models.col.name: Model
models.total: To download: {size} GB. Free on disk: {free} GB.
models.no_space: Not enough space: {need} GB needed, {free} GB free. Free some space or deselect some models.
models.check_hint: The check runs each selected downloaded model on a short trial and shows how much video memory it needs.
models.reason.license: does not fit the chosen licence policy
models.reason.weights_missing: the model files are not downloaded
models.role.caption: audio description
tools.title: Programs and environments
tools.intro: Helper programs (for reading game files and handling audio) and model environments are installed here. Each is a one-button install.
tools.col.name: Program
tools.install: Download and install what is missing
tools.all_present: Everything that can be installed automatically is already installed.
tools.manual.title: Download manually ({n})
tools.manual.text: These programs cannot be downloaded automatically. Download them yourself using the links.
tools.ffmpeg.name: ffmpeg
tools.ffprobe.name: ffprobe
tools.ffprobe.purpose: Reads audio information. Comes with ffmpeg.
tools.vgmstream_cli.name: vgmstream
tools.vgmstream_cli.purpose: Reads game audio formats (.hca, .adx, .wem and others).
tools.rubberband.name: Rubber Band
tools.rubberband.purpose: Stretches audio in time without distorting the voice.
tools.unrpa.name: unrpa
tools.unrpyc.name: unrpyc
tools.xp3pack.name: Xp3Pack
tools.xp3pack.purpose: Builds the patch for KiriKiri games (.xp3).
tools.krkrdump.name: KrkrDump
tools.krkrdump.purpose: Saves the decrypted files of encrypted KiriKiri Z games.
tools.freemote_psbdecompile.name: FreeMote
tools.siglus_ssu.name: Siglus Scene Script Utility
tools.bgi_extractor.name: BGI Extractor
tools.vntextpatch.name: VNTextPatch
tools.vntextpatch.purpose: Extracts text from games on many engines.
tools.llama_server.name: llama.cpp (translation model server)
tools.llama_server.purpose: Runs the local translation model on the graphics card.
envs.title: Model environments
envs.intro: Models run in separate environments with the library versions they need. Compatible models share one environment: the main environment holds speech recognition, the Qwen3-TTS voices and quality scoring, so torch is downloaded once. Installing takes from a few minutes to an hour and downloads several gigabytes; the environments, Python and the download cache live in the environments folder (see Settings).
envs.torch.cpu_hint: Very slow. Choose only if you have no NVIDIA graphics card.
envs.funasr.name: Emotion analysis of voices
envs.main.name: Main environment: speech, Qwen3-TTS voices, quality scoring
envs.chatterbox.name: Voice: Chatterbox
envs.f5.name: Voice: F5 (Russian)
envs.gguf.name: Voices in GGUF format
envs.higgs.name: Voice: Higgs
envs.llm.name: Translation (local model)
envs.rvc.name: Voice conversion: RVC
envs.seedvc.name: Voice conversion: Seed-VC
casting.title: Voices
casting.intro: For each character the real voice is on the left and the proposed Russian voices are on the right. Listen and pick the one you like, or just press Automatic casting.
casting.auto_hint: Every character gets the best of the proposed voices. After that you can just press Next, or change any character's voice.
casting.no_characters: There are no characters yet. Go back to the Game step and analyse the game.
casting.no_audio: This character has no voice acting in the game, so there are no original samples. Voices are picked from a description: describe the character in your own words and listen to the result.
casting.description_placeholder: for example: a strict teacher, low voice
casting.upload_hint: A clean recording of one voice, without music or noise, between 5 and 20 seconds works well.
casting.brief_needed: Tell us about the character first: describe the voice in words (on the left) or upload a voice sample. Then you can generate voices.
casting.clone_warning: A quick way, but Russian speech may get an accent: the clone repeats the timbre of the original, not its pronunciation.
casting.listen: Listen to how it will sound
casting.library.save: Save the voice to the library
casting.library.name: Voice name
casting.library.saved: The voice was saved to the library.
casting.library.intro: These are voices saved in other projects. You can reuse them.
casting.library.empty: The library is empty. You can save a voice on a character's card after choosing it.
casting.library.added: The voice was added to the options for “{name}”.
casting.rvc.title: Training the voice to match the original runs in the background
casting.confirm.title: Not every character has a voice
casting.confirm.text: {n} characters have no voice yet. You can assign them voices automatically and continue, or go back and choose yourself.
tuning.title: Voice tuning
tuning.line_hint: These settings apply only to the current line; the others stay as they are.
tuning.applied_none: There are no similar characters (same gender and age).
preview.title: Quick preview
preview.intro: Before dubbing the whole game we make a small piece: you hear how it will sound and can change the voices or settings.
preview.mode: What to voice for the trial
preview.mode.first_n_hint: Say how many lines to voice.
preview.run_hint: Takes a few minutes; the time is shown while it works.
preview.results_hint: For each line you can listen to the original and the dub.
preview.no_audio: There is no audio for this line.
preview.empty: The preview has not been made yet. Press Make the preview.
run.title: Full run
run.intro: Dubbing the whole game. This is the longest part and can take several hours. It is better not to load the computer with other things meanwhile.
run.shutdown: Turn the computer off when finished
run.shutdown_hint: Handy if you start it for the night.
run.shutdown_warning: The computer will turn off by itself when everything is done. Save your other work.
run.closable: You can close the window: the work will stop, and the next time you start the app it will offer to continue from the same place.
run.done.title: The dub is ready
run.done.text: Now you can check the result: listen to the lines the app is unsure about and fix them.
coverage.title: What is in the patch
coverage.provisional: Lines dubbed provisionally: {n}. The best take of each failed the quality checks but is in the patch anyway. Listen to them in the Review step.
coverage.left_out: Lines left out of the patch: {n}. They stay silent in the game. Reasons: {reasons}.
coverage.narration: Narration lines without a voice: {n}. Narration is not dubbed, by design.
coverage.reason.not_mastered: the sound could not be built
coverage.chip.provisional_title: Lines where no take passed the quality checks: the best one is in the patch. Worth listening to in the Review step.
coverage.chip.left_out_title: These lines stay silent in the game. Reasons: {reasons}.
run.next_hint: Wait for the run to finish.
review.title: Review
review.intro: Lines that need attention come first. Lines marked "needs a check" are already in the patch as provisional: you can leave them, but it is better to listen. Listen, accept the variant you like, or ask for a new take. Use the keyboard for speed.
review.select_line: Choose a line on the left.
review.filter.speaker: Character
review.prefer_a: Mark all as A where it is better by default
review.prefer_a_hint: For every line where the route A variant passed its checks, that variant will be chosen.

install.engine.title: What this game needs
install.md.title: Detailed technical instructions (in English)
install.engine.renpy.steps: The patch's “game” folder is copied over your game's “game” folder: Ren'Py reads loose files before archives, so the new voices replace the originals. Lines that had no voice in the game are hooked up by a separate file from the patch (Ren'Py 7.4 or newer); copy it too. If the game forces archives only, the voices have to be packed into an .rpa archive by hand, see the technical instructions below.
install.engine.kirikiri.steps: The patch is a file such as patch.xp3: put it next to the game's executable. KiriKiri loads such files after the main archive, so the new voices replace the originals. If the game's archives are encrypted, the game may refuse the patch: then the version.dll library from KirikiriTools has to be put next to the game by hand.
install.engine.nscripter.steps: The contents of the patch folder are copied next to the game's executable, keeping the subfolders. ONScripter reads loose files before the arc*.nsa archives, so the new voices replace the originals.
install.engine.siglus.steps: The new voices are in the koe_dump folder under the same names as the originals. SiglusEngine reads voices only from koe/*.ovk files, and the app cannot build such files. They have to be rebuilt with a third-party tool, keeping the order of the entries, and replaced in the game by hand.
install.engine.bgi.steps: Copy the contents of the patch folder into the game folder, keeping the subfolders. If the voices are not replaced after that, the engine reads them only from archives: then the voices have to be packed into an archive with a BGI tool. See the technical instructions below for details.
install.engine.catsystem2.steps: The game's voices are kept in pcm_*.int archives. The archives have to be rebuilt by hand with CatSceneEditor, putting in the files from the patch under the same names. Encrypted archives cannot be rebuilt with known tools: for such games the patch cannot be installed yet.
install.engine.artemis.steps: From the “files” folder an archive has to be built by hand with pfs-rs or pfs_unpacker. Give it a name such as root.pfs.001 so that Artemis loads it after the original archives, and put it into the game folder.
install.engine.tyrano.steps: The patch's “data” folder is copied over the game's “data” folder, keeping the subfolders. If the game is packed into app.asar or a single exe file, it has to be unpacked first and run from the unpacked folder.
install.engine.unity.steps: Unity games have no simple way to replace files: the patch is installed by hand with a Python script (the UnityPy library is needed). The method is experimental: first make a copy of the game's data folder (it is called “…_Data”). Step-by-step instructions are below.
install.engine.yuris.steps: A YU-RIS game keeps its voices in YPF archives. To replace the voices the archive has to be rebuilt by hand, which needs the archive's encryption key (the YPF_Tool or ypf-repacker utilities). The patch files are already prepared in the patch folder; see below for details.
install.engine.majiro.steps: The patch files are copied into the game folder, keeping the subfolders. If Majiro takes voices only from archives, the voices have to be packed into an archive with MajiroTools. See the technical instructions below for details.
install.engine.generic.steps: The contents of the patch folder are copied into the game folder, keeping the subfolders. If the game takes voices only from archives, they have to be packed with a tool for your engine. See the technical instructions below for details.

settings.paths.confirm_default: The default folder inside the data folder will be used.
settings.paths.confirm_models: Models already downloaded are not moved automatically: you will have to download them again in the new folder or move the files yourself. The old folder stays on the disk.
settings.paths.confirm_envs: Installed environments are not moved: they have to be installed again in the new folder (a download of several gigabytes). Python and the download cache move with them. The old folder stays on the disk and can be deleted by hand. This folder can only be changed while nothing is running.
errors.python_junction_blocked.title: Windows did not let the program into the Python link folder: {path}.
errors.python_junction_blocked.hint: Delete that link folder in Explorer (the Python files themselves are in the neighbouring folder with the full version number and stay) and press Retry.
